title: Ginger and Green Chilli Paste Surti Style | Ginger and Green Chilli Paste Surti Style
description: Ginger and Green Chilli Paste Surati Style  150 gm - Green Chillies 50 gm - Ginger  2-3 no - Lemon Juice 1/2 tsp - Turmeric Powder Salt to taste  1 tsp - Peanut Oil   Grind it like Coarse

asr.full_text: Hello friends welcome to foodcouture I am Chetna patel and today I am going to share with you the fine ginger & green chili paste mostly this paste is used in Surat so we use less of Red chili paste even in the vegetables of mutin we don't use Red Chili paste and use this paste only the Phrasans are very tasty and you know that but, all those Phrasans are made from the same paste like water-gourd curry mixture, semolina, semolina, sago, cardamom, chana dal amomum , kollijen jaggery , and the most popular of surat, kundia is also made from this. and this paste is prepared with proper method. Let me tell you during the recipe how to make this. 1 Special type of Chilli is used here. So let me tell you what type of Chilli is used here? To make this paste, you need look for this type of chilli in bottle. but very spicy This chili is very hot If we add little chili, It becomes really tasty Any recipe can be made I have one and a half 100 gram green chillies Look how tiny green this is It is very spicy, but also tasty I have taken 100 grams of green chilli Apart from this, This is ginger and become very tasty and spicy So 1 & half 100 gm of this and here I've taken ginger that I've peeled and extracted and I've cut it into a small pieces Here I've taken 50 gm of ginger with this we'll put 2-3 Lemon Juice Salt Turmeric Powder and little bit of oil To prepare green paste, I have taken 150 gm of chili We will take the cold ice water and will add the chili into it and along with that add 50 gram of ginger I am using 50gramm of ginger while the heat is summer add ginger while the heat is winter add ginger after that, keep it in cold water for 10-15 mins and make paste now the stems and the chillis are out Now i have taken out the stem of these chilies And we are going to put these in cold water You can see that this with some ice in it Keep it in water for 10-15 minutes as you can see it has already added a little bit of ginger and I am taking out a few of it And again wash them after 2-3 times and then keep it in cold water Its been 15 minutes and I will take a mixer jar and pour water and add all chillies and ginger and green chillies to the jar. Add Lemon juice In salt add Lemon juice 2 to 3 Lemon juice In salt I am adding 1.5 table spoon of salt 1 Heats teaspoonbs turmeric powder then add oil 2 tbsp then crushed in mixer check check it you can see color looks very nice green chili is very fresh not very fine and you have to crush it not very fine and you have to crush the chutney a little fine It's almost like a rough paste roughly crushed Now we will put the paste in a glass bowl As you can see the paste is ready Now add little oil and make sure that this chutney is not black Now pour the mixture into the container Paste is ready Now we'll put this in airtight container. Our paste is ready. If you keep it in the normal refrigerator, then this paste will last for 15 to 20 days. If you deep freeze it, it will last for 2 months. If you take it out after 2 months and deep-freeze it, then it will stay in the same color and will not turn black. If you try this at home you can see they are not black So you have to be careful while preparing this And do use those chilies like the one i used This is the same type of chili This gives good taste Add this to cold water We will get green paste Don't forget to keep in cold water This will help to keep green color of paste I have mentioned about this red chilli paste in my many recipes I have shared about this is used in many dishes. Today, I will show you how to make Indian style green lentils which are extremely spicy. I am using this kind of paste for all the dishes. Green Vata, Amma, Green Gedi, Green lentil, and Semolina This paste is made in less quantity but taste good When we prepare paste first or second day, it will be very spicy And when it gets to old, it will become mild, If you have this paste, then you can make any type of recipe. You don't need to make ginger and green chilli paste. Serve hot If you like my recipe then please Like, Share this video and Subscribe to my Channel Also, please click the bell icon around my home Try this recipe and let us know in comments How was the recipe? We will be waiting for your comments We will be back with another recipe Till then, Happy Cooking
